specs.Supported Application: TV, PC, Music, Movies, Games, Podcasts, etc.

features: ✅【3-in-1 Bluetooth 5.0 Transmitter/Receiver with Bypass Mode】: The Sounce Bluetooth Audio Adapter offers three versatile modes in one compact unit—Transmit (TX), Receive (RX), and Bypass. In TX mode, it transmits high-quality audio wirelessly from TVs or PCs to Bluetooth headphones or speakers. RX mode allows your non-Bluetooth home stereo to receive audio from your phone.

✅【Smart LCD Display with Convenient Volume Control Knob】: Featuring an LCD screen, this is the first Bluetooth transmitter that displays nearby Bluetooth devices for easier pairing and device management. Easily view up to 8 available devices at a time. The integrated volume control knob lets you adjust the audio level directly on the adapter (note: it doesn't amplify sound, just controls volume).

✅【Supports Multiple Audio Inputs: Optical, AUX & RCA】: This Bluetooth adapter supports flexible connectivity options with 3.5mm AUX, RCA, and advanced TOSLINK optical input/output. Whether your TV uses optical output or your speaker setup uses RCA or AUX, this device integrates seamlessly for full compatibility with modern and traditional audio systems.

✅【Dual Device Pairing – Connect 2 Headphones Simultaneously】: Designed with family and shared entertainment in mind, the Sounce transmitter supports dual link pairing—allowing you to connect two Bluetooth headphones or speakers at the same time. Great for couples, kids, or shared audio experiences without disturbing others.

✅【Always On – No Charging Needed】: Unlike portable Bluetooth transmitters, the Sounce adapter is designed to remain plugged in at all times. With no internal battery to charge, you get continuous operation without interruptions—perfect for everyday home use.
